integrate.idea: Spike-first sidecar contract probe: before any pipeline code, run a REAL interactive claude PTY for 3 turns, kill it, and diff the produced ~/.claude/projects/<slug> JSONL against parser expectations; pin the observed shape as the canonical fixture and gate the whole capture design on this spike's findings (per FM-01).
integrate.note: Receipt: FM-01 says the parser may find nothing it recognizes; the spike converts an assumed sidecar schema into an observed one before a single wave is planned.

integrate.idea: Sum-over-message-usage parser design: compute session cost as the sum of per-message usage blocks (not find-the-session-total-record), with explicit states 'measured', 'partial: resumed elsewhere', and 'unmeasured' — never a guessed total.
integrate.note: Directly mitigates FM-01's relabeled zero-by-omission; partial state is honest, not fabricated.

integrate.idea: Capture engine_session_id AT LAUNCH: watch the project slug dir for the new JSONL created within a tight window while holding the session lock (or parse the PTY banner), store the UUID on the registry record; any record without a captured UUID is honestly 'uncorrelated' — never mtime-guessed after the fact.
integrate.note: Kills FM-02 (wrong-session attribution) at the root; correlation becomes a fact recorded at start, not a heuristic at end.

integrate.idea: Eager finalize + heartbeat snapshot: copy the usage summary into .anchor/ at EVERY end path (kill, close/park, drain, finish) plus a periodic heartbeat copy for long-lived sessions, so reconcile-dead weeks later reads Anchor's own durable snapshot, never the prunable ~/.claude store.
integrate.note: Mitigates FM-03; the sidecar is treated as transient source, .anchor/ as the durable record — consistent with the v8 persist-before-reap keystone philosophy.

integrate.idea: Tokens+time as first-class measured truth; dollars OPTIONAL and shown only when the engine itself reported a nonzero costUSD — render 'N tok · Xm (subscription)' on the Max-subscription host; a no-own-pricing-table rule locked at plan level so no wave adds one.
integrate.note: Mitigates FM-04's fabrication-by-multiplication; 'measured truth' means what the engine reported, nothing derived.

integrate.idea: Append-only usage LEDGER keyed by (engine_session_uuid, message_uuid/line-hash): a session's cost = sum of ledger lines attributed to it; re-ingesting the same sidecar (engine-switch relaunch, continue-session resumed history) is idempotent by key, making double-count structurally impossible.
integrate.note: FM-08's engine-side dedup; the invariant 'switch_engine total = A-part + B-part counted once' becomes a pinned test.

integrate.idea: Rollup dedup pinned by test: persist docs (source=discovered) AND attach a RUN cost record for the SAME session_id in one test, assert the rollup counts the cost exactly once and the discovered doc-effort contributes 0 — extending the existing effort_view session_id rule into the cost domain.
integrate.note: Directly implements criterion 3's proof obligation and pins the FM-08 discovered-vs-run coexistence case.

integrate.idea: Wave-0 closed-world test audit: enumerate every existing rollup/persist assertion (v4/v8 suites), classify each as additive-compatible (new cost source off-by-default in legacy fixtures via the sidecar-seam env) vs legitimately superseded (documented in the plan) — no improvised test rewrites under wave pressure.
integrate.note: FM-12 mitigation; the 'existing suites stay green unmodified' constraint is only satisfiable if the new source is opt-in for legacy fixtures, and that must be decided now.

integrate.idea: Fail-closed sidecar-root seam in paths.py: under ANCHOR_DATA_DIR/healthcheck/test mode the resolver RAISES rather than resolving the live ~/.claude store unless ANCHOR_SIDECAR_DIR is explicitly set; a STUB-GATE test spies the resolver and asserts the healthcheck run never opens a real-home path — mirroring the never-8777 guard.
integrate.note: FM-13; the CODE_DIR-swap healthcheck bug is the historical receipt that this exact class of leak happens here.

integrate.idea: Atomic-write hardening LANDS BEFORE the finalize wave: temp-file+rename under WRITE_LOCK for exactly the files finalize touches (registry, effort index, ledger), finalize as compare-and-set on a cost_final flag keyed by session_id, plus a 50× kill/close/reconcile race stress test asserting exactly one record and parseable indexes.
integrate.note: FM-14; the 2026-07-08 architecture review already flagged non-atomic writes in rnd_registry/effort_history as the #1 durability bug — this wave has an existing receipt.

integrate.idea: B2 tile bugs reproduced against the REAL ConPTY backend first (Playwright), each classified state-bug (fixture-testable) vs attach-race (needs a WS attach-ack/replay-complete protocol change), and planned as separate items — only then fixed, with per-tile-class screenshot sign-off.
integrate.note: FM-09; a deterministic-fixture 'fix' of a race would pass tests and fail live — the classification step is the mitigation.

integrate.idea: WS attach-ack/replay-complete handshake: the terminal window renders only after the server acks the attach and signals replay-buffer-complete, eliminating the blank-window race as a protocol property rather than a timing hope.
integrate.note: The concrete engineering shape FM-09's race classification will likely demand; pre-scoping it avoids a mid-wave surprise.

integrate.idea: Two-step tile affordance: click = PASSIVE warm view (cached summary + doc-role narration + pending NEXT-PROMPT as paste-not-submit, zero PTY, zero engine turns, free); an explicit '▶ Resume live' control = spawn + orientation. Reuse an already-live session for the same effort instead of spawning a sibling.
integrate.note: Mitigates FM-06 and FM-07 simultaneously; 'reliably opens a warm terminal that narrates' is satisfied by the two-step without dashboard browsing costing 250k tokens.

integrate.idea: Orientation runs harness-enforced read-only: if any auto-executed narration survives the design fork, it runs as a one-shot plan-mode job through job_runner (permission_mode='plan', like Gandalf shards) — NEVER a seeded turn on the live interactive PTY; ACTION prompts remain v10 paste-NOT-submit, pinned by a test asserting no ACTION prompt is ever auto-submitted.
integrate.note: FM-06: a prompt-text 'read-only classifier' is judgment with extra steps; plan-mode is the only enforcement the codebase already trusts (Gandalf Stage-A precedent).

integrate.idea: One-time summary BACKFILL wave ships FIRST: batch-summarize from persisted docs/transcripts through the runner seam (stubbed in tests, throttled live) for brownfield, pre-v7, general, and failed-summary sessions; measure coverage % on the real registry before/after so 'any tile narrates' is true on day one, not aspirational.
integrate.note: FM-10; the known general-session surface gap and pre-summarize-on-finish sessions are the tiles users actually click.

integrate.idea: Substantive degraded seed: when no cached summary exists even after backfill, the warm view still shows doc list + lane + dates + last transcript tail (the W3 synthesizer already builds this) — 'degraded' never means blank.
integrate.note: FM-10's second half; guarantees the non-blank-window criterion (4) for every tile class including discovered.

integrate.idea: Per-ENGINE-SEGMENT measurement model: each engine segment of a session is measured/unmeasured independently; the session badge shows 'partial (gemini segment unmeasured)' rather than a complete-looking Claude-only number; Gemini CLI telemetry-file investigation is an explicit fast-follow item, not silently pretended complete.
integrate.note: FM-11; on this both-subscriptions 5:1 host a per-session boolean would systematically lie about switched sessions.

integrate.idea: Live drift tripwire the healthcheck CAN run: a NON-model, read-only parse of the most recent real sidecars already on disk, report.warn (never red, per the locked severity rule) when zero of the last N real session files yield usage — catching a CLI-upgrade schema rename that pinned fixtures would mask forever.
integrate.note: FM-05; the healthcheck's all-model-calls-stubbed contract makes a stubbed tripwire useless — read-only real-file parsing is the loophole that respects the contract.

integrate.idea: Capture-rate stamped on the rollup itself: 'measured 14/17 sessions (30d)' rendered next to the totals, so capture decay is visible on the dashboard where John looks daily, not only in 5AM reports.
integrate.note: FM-05's second mitigation; also makes the honesty contract legible — the number advertises its own coverage.

integrate.idea: Prospective undercount measurement: reframe criterion (7) as capture-rate on NEW sessions for one week post-deploy (target ≥90% of Claude-engine sessions measured), with historical backfill reported as an explicit 'attributed / surviving / total' breakdown — never a single recovered-% headline built on pruned or misattributed sidecars.
integrate.note: FM-16; a retrospective-only number is uncomputable (FM-03) or a lie (FM-02) — the prospective frame is the honest observable.

integrate.idea: Orientation-session lifecycle tags for the zombie-hunter: click-resumed sessions carry an origin marker the live-owner computation treats as owned-for-N-minutes, then auto-park (graceful close, docs persisted); a bounded parked-worktree budget with oldest-first graceful eviction (docs already persisted to main → eviction loses nothing) plus a dashboard count.
integrate.note: FM-15; without this the W6 keep-idle-worktrees rule + warm resume accumulates unbounded parked worktrees and floods the swarm banner with false orphans — a safety-critical surface per the 2026-06-30 swarm-warning fix.

integrate.idea: Healthcheck gains a fully-stubbed capture+finalize walk: a fake sidecar fixture (pinned from the B1 spike) is written into the temp ANCHOR_SIDECAR_DIR, a stub session is started/killed, and the check asserts a RUN cost record with the fixture's exact totals lands in the temp registry — extending the v2–v5 surface-walk pattern.
integrate.note: Criterion 6 names this explicitly; the existing check_rnd_vN_surface pattern is the template, so cost is low.

integrate.idea: One live smoke run as deploy sign-off: after deploy, run one real interactive session, kill it, and assert the rollup delta equals the sidecar's reported usage (tokens exact, time within tolerance) — the only place a REAL sidecar meets the parser outside the drift tripwire.
integrate.note: Criterion 1 requires it verbatim; also the project's established live-sign-off discipline (the v4 lesson).

integrate.idea: 'Unmeasured' as a first-class visual state in the rollup UI: a distinct badge/color for unmeasured vs $0.00/0-tok, with hover text naming the reason (sidecar pruned, uncorrelated, gemini segment, pre-feature session) — the reason enum comes from the finalize pipeline, not free text.
integrate.note: Criterion 2 requires the distinction; an enum of reasons makes it machine-verifiable and testable rather than cosmetic.

integrate.idea: NEXT-PROMPT.md and the cached summary become the warm view's narration spine: the passive view renders 'what was done' (cached summary), 'what was produced' (doc-roles map with /report//artifact links), and 'what comes next' (the durable NEXT-PROMPT.md / pending_paste) — all three already exist as durable artifacts, so narration is a render, not a model call.
integrate.note: The North Star's narrate/produce/next triplet maps 1:1 onto v10/v8 artifacts already on disk; zero new model spend for the common case.

integrate.idea: Cost ledger heartbeat piggybacks the existing 120s session-autosave heartbeat (2026-07-07) rather than adding a second timer — one periodic hook does transcript persist + usage snapshot.
integrate.note: Oranges foresight: two independent heartbeats on the same session invite drift and double writes; the autosave hook already fires at every point B4 needs.

integrate.idea: One-shot job_runner jobs join the same ledger: the durable job path (lane launches, Gandalf shards, summarizer runs) already parses stream-json usage — route its totals through the SAME append-only ledger keyed by engine session UUID so 'every Anchor session — interactive ConPTY or one-shot job' is literally one code path.
integrate.note: The North Star's 'or one-shot job' clause; unifying prevents the interactive and job pipelines from disagreeing on dedup keys later.

integrate.idea: Registry-state fixture capture tooling: a small dev command that snapshots a project's live session_registry + effort store into an anonymized fixture directory, so the B2 Playwright reproductions run against CAPTURED real states (criterion 4's 'captured registry-state fixtures') instead of hand-built ones.
integrate.note: The criterion names captured fixtures; hand-authored states are how the fixture-passes-production-fails trap (FM-09) starts.

integrate.idea: Lock the fork decision in the North Star doc as a written amendment: orientation = auto-executed READ-ONLY narration via plan-mode one-shot (or fully passive render if the spike shows plan-mode unenforceable on the chosen path); ACTION = paste-not-submit, always — recorded before Stage 2 so no wave relitigates it.
integrate.note: Criterion 5 says 'the fork is resolved, locked in the North Star doc'; leaving it implicit is how FM-06 ships.

integrate.idea: Gemini CLI usage-capture spike (fast-follow scoped, not this plan's gate): inventory what session/telemetry files the gemini CLI and agy dispatcher leave on disk, and whether a UUID-at-launch correlation is possible — outcome feeds the per-segment model but does NOT block the Claude-path waves.
integrate.note: FM-11's investigate-don't-pretend clause; explicitly sequenced as non-blocking so the 5:1 host reality doesn't stall the whole plan.

integrate.idea: Boneyard entries carry the final cost block: when a session is killed-to-Boneyard, its finalized usage rides on the boneyard entry, so discarded work's spend remains visible history rather than vanishing with the tile.
integrate.note: Every end path finalizes (criterion 1) — Boneyard-kill is an end path; surfacing it there is a one-field render on data the finalize already produced.

grasscatcher.idea: Weekly cost digest email/notification summarizing per-project measured spend and capture rate.
grasscatcher.note: Reporting cadence/notification is a new surface; no criterion asks for push reporting — the rollup + dashboard stamp cover the honesty goal.

grasscatcher.idea: Per-session cost BUDGETS with a warn/park threshold (auto-park a session that crosses N tokens).
grasscatcher.note: Enforcement/limits is a different feature; the North Star is measurement honesty, not spend control. Park in Grasscatcher — it becomes cheap once the ledger exists.

grasscatcher.idea: Cross-project cost analytics view (trend charts, per-lane spend over time, engine mix).
grasscatcher.note: Analytics beyond the existing rollup window (lifetime/30d) traces to no criterion; the ledger makes it a later render-only feature.

grasscatcher.idea: Export the usage ledger as CSV for external accounting.
grasscatcher.note: No criterion mentions export; trivially buildable later off the append-only ledger.

grasscatcher.idea: Retention policy for .anchor/ usage snapshots (compaction of old ledger lines into per-session totals after M months).
grasscatcher.note: Premature: snapshot volume is tiny JSON; add compaction only if the store measurably grows. Grasscatcher with the receipt that FM-03 argues for MORE retention, not less, right now.
